<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def blocks(fr):
    out=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N':
            b=n['boundary']; out.append((min(p[0] for p in b),min(p[1] for p in b)))
    return sorted(out)
def ply(fr):
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='Y':
            b=n['boundary']; return (min(p[0] for p in b),min(p[1] for p in b))
    return None
print('before step',current_frame.step,'blocks',blocks(current_frame),'ply',ply(current_frame))
r=action(['RIGHT'])
print('after',r.get('step'),'blocks',blocks(current_frame),'ply',ply(current_frame))
print('result',{k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','reward','done','game_over','level_completed')})
</parameter>
